HELM AG and Parijat Industries Forge Agri-Commerce Partnership

German company HELM AG and Indian firm Parijat Industries have entered into a strategic partnership. The collaboration focuses on digital agri-commerce, manufacturing, and distribution within the agricultural sector. This pact aims to leverage digital platforms for enhanced agricultural business operations. Both companies will work together on the production and supply chain of agricultural products.
